registration.method: bicubic resample; NCC of luma over the original area without the field (+8 px) and a 16 px rim; pattern search on scale and translation

seam_field.rule: ВР-VS2-EN.10: one smooth 2D field over the whole outside (membrane / Laplace), Dirichlet = (original - generation) in linear light on the original's outermost ring (gaussian ring_sigma_px along the ring; 0 = exact), 0 at the canvas edge; decay outward 188 px top/bottom, 334 px left/right (>= 96)

edge_darkening.curve: per side smoothstep of the normalised distance from the old border line to the canvas edge, product over sides; outside the original only; linear light

local_warp.rule:
Local warp along the old border (ВР-VS2-EN.10 assembly, geometry only): NCC block matching of the globally
registered generation against the original in 64x48 windows just inside each side, every 32 px, +-4 px with a
parabolic sub-pixel peak; windows on the field, flat ones (std < 2) or with NCC < 0.6 are dropped. The ring
displacement is a Gaussian-weighted mean of the samples (sigma 40 px, by Euclidean distance, so corners mix both
sides); the field is that value at the nearest ring point, fading to 0 over 128 px away from the ring, then
smoothed (sigma 8 px).

seam.definition: ВР-VS2-EN.7: linear Rec.709 Y*255; mean |dY| across a line parallel to the old border at offset d (d<0 original, d=0 original|extension, d>0 extension); pass G(0) <= 1.5 x median G(d), 1<=|d|<=64; 64 px segments for inspection only

water_screen.note: screening number only; the verdict on water is visual (Read PNG)
